summary: ReTo Eco-Solutions filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering a registered direct offering of 10,000,000 Class A shares at $1.50 per share plus 10,000,000 warrants at a $2.75 exercise price, for aggregate gross proceeds up to $15,000,000 under a September 17, 2026 securities purchase agreement. Warrants are immediately exercisable, expire in one year, and carry a cashless and a zero-price exercise feature with a $0.50 floor; up to 90,000,000 shares may underlie. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and the warrant overhang.
